text.25:61: Blessed be He Who hath placed in the heaven mansions of the stars, and hath placed therein a great lamp and a moon giving light!
text.33:46: And as a summoner unto Allah by His permission, and as a lamp that giveth light.
text.71:16: And hath made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp?
text.78:13: And have appointed a dazzling lamp,
